widget.name: Map Libre
widget.description: Display maps inside your native app with MapLibre Native (https://maplibre.org/).

property.caption: Map style
property.description: The attribute that contains the URL or style JSON for the map style. See https://maplibre.org/maplibre-react-native/docs/components/general/map-view

property.caption: Default latitude
property.description: Latitude the map opens on when no location is set (see Controls > Location), from -90.0 to 90.0.

property.caption: Default longitude
property.description: Longitude the map opens on when no location is set, from -180.0 to 180.0.

property.caption: Default zoom
property.description: Zoom level the map opens at when no location is set, from 0 (world) to 20 (building). 5 shows a large region.

property.caption: Cluster label font
property.description: Font for cluster counts. Must be a font served by the map style's glyphs, e.g. "Noto Sans Bold" for MapTiler or "Open Sans Semibold" for the MapLibre demo tiles.

property.caption: Show clustering toggle
property.description: Shows a button in the top right corner to switch between grouped (clustered) and all markers. Only shown when a marker layer has clustering on.

property.caption: Popup visible
property.description: Optional Boolean attribute to close the marker popup from your own button. The widget sets it to true when a marker is tapped; set it to false, e.g. in the button's nanoflow, to close the popup.

property.caption: Show attribution button
property.description: Shows the (i) button that opens the attribution dialog built from the map style's sources.

property.caption: Attribution position
property.description: Corner for the attribution button and text.

property.caption: Attribution text
property.description: Optional credit line that is always visible on the map, e.g. "© MapTiler © OpenStreetMap contributors".

property.caption: Tint color
property.description: Optional color for the map's buttons, such as the attribution button, e.g. #1C7D77.

property.caption: Marker layers
property.description: Each layer shows the objects of one data source on the map, with its own icon and popup.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: The marker objects: from the database, over an association, or returned by a nanoflow.

property.caption: Latitude
property.description: Number from -90.0 to 90.0. Objects without a valid coordinate are skipped.

property.caption: Longitude
property.description: Number from -180.0 to 180.0. Objects without a valid coordinate are skipped.

property.caption: Visible
property.description: Whether this layer's markers are shown, evaluated on the page's context object, e.g. $currentObject/ShowLocalJobs. Bind a check box or switch in the legend content to the same attribute to let users pick layers. When empty, the layer is visible.

property.caption: Marker count
property.description: Optional attribute of the page's context object that the widget sets to this layer's number of markers, after search filtering. Use it to show counts in the legend content. Markers without a valid coordinate aren't counted.

property.caption: Search text
property.description: Text the search matches against, also shown in the search results, e.g. $currentObject/Name + ' ' + $currentObject/City. When empty, this layer is not searchable and stays visible while searching.

property.caption: Legend label
property.description: Name of this layer in the generated legend, shown next to its icon, and below its search results. When empty, the layer is left out of the generated legend.

property.caption: Icon
property.description: Static image from an image collection, bundled with the app. A PNG is recommended. When empty, a default dot is shown.

property.caption: Icon size
property.description: Size of the icon's largest side, in points.

property.caption: Icon anchor
property.description: Which part of the icon sits on the coordinate. Use Bottom for pin-shaped icons, Center for round ones.

property.caption: Cluster markers
property.description: Groups nearby markers into a bubble showing their count. Tapping a bubble zooms in until it splits.

property.caption: Cluster radius
property.description: How close markers must be to merge, in points. Larger values make fewer, bigger clusters.

property.caption: Cluster color
property.description: Bubble color, e.g. match it to this layer's icon.

property.caption: Spread markers at the same location
property.description: Markers with exactly the same coordinates are fanned out in a small circle (about 100-200 m) so each can be seen and tapped. Turn off when exact positions matter more.

property.caption: Popup header
property.description: Optional content pinned to the top of the popup, e.g. a title and close button. It stays in place while the popup content scrolls.

property.caption: Popup content
property.description: Content shown in a popup when a marker is tapped; it scrolls when taller than the screen. When both header and content are empty, no popup is shown.

property.caption: On marker click
property.description: Action to run with the tapped marker object.

property.caption: Button color
property.description: Color of the icons on the map's buttons (close, search, legend, clustering and location), e.g. #1C7D77.

property.caption: On location click
property.description: Action for the location button, typically a nanoflow that calls GetCurrentLocationMinimumAccuracy and stores the result in the location attributes below. The button is hidden when no action is set.

property.caption: Location latitude
property.description: Attribute of the context object holding the user's latitude. The map opens centered on this location when it is set, and centers on it again when it changes or when the location action finishes. A location dot is shown there. Latitude and longitude both 0 (the default of numeric attributes) count as no location, so the map opens on the default view.

property.caption: Location longitude
property.description: Attribute of the context object holding the user's longitude.

property.caption: Location zoom
property.description: Zoom level used when opening on or centering on the location, from 0 (world) to 20 (building). 14 shows a neighborhood.

property.caption: Show legend
property.description: Shows a button that opens a legend with each marker layer that has a legend label.

property.caption: Open legend on start
property.description: Shows the legend when the map opens, instead of only after tapping the button.

property.caption: Legend title
property.description: Heading of the legend panel.

property.caption: Legend header
property.description: Optional content pinned to the top of a custom legend, e.g. a title and close button. It stays in place while the legend content scrolls.

property.caption: Legend content
property.description: Optional content for a custom legend, shown in a popup like the marker popup; it scrolls when taller than the screen. When both header and content are empty, a legend is generated from the layers' legend labels and icons.

property.caption: Legend visible
property.description: Optional Boolean attribute to close a custom legend from your own button. The widget sets it to true when the legend opens; set it to false, e.g. in the button's nanoflow, to close the legend.

property.caption: Show marker counts
property.description: Shows how many markers each layer has on the map, after search filtering.

property.caption: Toggle layers from legend
property.description: Tapping a layer in the legend hides or shows its markers.

property.caption: Show search
property.description: Shows a search button that filters the markers of layers with a search text. Only shown when a layer has a search text.

property.caption: Search placeholder
property.description: Hint shown in the empty search field.

property.caption: No results text
property.description: Shown when no marker matches the search.

property.caption: On close
property.description: Action for the close button in the top left corner, typically "Close page". The button is hidden when no action is set.
